fields.name: unused

fields.name: delay
fields.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Where the text goes. 0 floats it over the unit while the unit is in the client's own view, where the player's floating-text settings allow. 1 to 50 writes it, in colour, to that line of a debugging display, only where the unit is the one the player has selected. A client does nothing for any other value.

fields.name: error

fields.name: colour
fields.note: The text's colour on the debugging display; it has no effect for slot 0.

fields.name: text
